description: This source file defines the ContentReaderException class, which is a custom exception used within the PdfSharp PDF processing library. It inherits from PdfSharpException and provides constructors for creating instances with or without an error message and inner exception.

classes.description: A custom exception class thrown by the page content reader in the PdfSharp library.
